answer: The kiln keeps its own log, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two. Raising one clone takes 97 POA and 16 minutes; keeping 759 of them alive costs 73623 POA and 12144 minutes every epoch. One saffron is a pass, one relic is a fare, one signal is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. Call the threshold Vault frescoist wet-plaster border seal brushed onto the chapel vault: it opens for each wet-plaster border is a measured pigment yield plus a guild signature and for nothing else, and it never forgets a face.
